fair_value.method: Sum of the parts on ~3.55B diluted shares, 12 months out: core auto on ~$1.6-2.0 2027 EPS attributable to autos at ~40x = $70; energy storage (~$13-14 GWh/qtr, ~$12-13B rev, 20% GM) at ~25x earnings = $35; FSD software (1.48M subs growing ~50%/yr) = $50; robotaxi/Cybercab option (7 metros, ~550 vehicles in Texas, Cybercab paying rides since Sep-3) = $135; Optimus option = $45. Total ~$335, i.e. ~10% below spot; consensus 2027 EPS ~$2.20 implies ~150x at spot.

bear.story: Auto margins stay compressed (Q2 op margin 1.4%), FCF stays negative on >$25B capex, NHTSA Cybercab Special Order forces pause/recall, robotaxi scaling slips, Optimus production delayed; multiple de-rates toward ~100x depressed EPS; possible SpaceX merger overhang/dilution fears.

base.story: Deliveries ~1.8-1.9M in 2026 growing modestly, gross margin ~18-20%, robotaxi expands to ~10-15 metros with a few thousand vehicles, Optimus low-volume production begins; EPS ~$2 in 2027 and the market keeps paying a large autonomy premium; stock roughly flat.

bull.story: Cybercab clears NHTSA, fleet scales to tens of thousands with visible per-mile economics, FSD approvals in China/EU broaden, Optimus shows external customer deployment, capex begins to show returns; stock retests/exceeds prior high ~$499 and moves toward $2T market cap.

thesis_break_reason: ~13% below the 52-week low ($297) and ~30% below spot; trading there would most likely reflect a fundamental impairment of the autonomy narrative (regulatory halt of driverless Cybercab/robotaxi operations, serious safety incident, or clear Optimus/robotaxi delays) combined with negative FCF and eroding auto margins, rather than ordinary 46%-vol noise.

catalysts.event: Tesla response due to NHTSA Special Order on Cybercab FMVSS self-certification
Q3 2026 earnings (tentative): margins, capex, FCF, robotaxi/Optimus timelines
China full FSD approval (targeted Q3 2026, slipping) and further EU country approvals
Optimus first-gen production start; Semi and Megapack 3 production ramp
Robotaxi metro expansion (Las Vegas allocation, additional states) and Cybercab volume ramp
Any Tesla-SpaceX combination proposal or Musk-related governance/dilution news

key_uncertainties: Regulatory outcome of NHTSA Cybercab audit/Special Order and pace of unsupervised robotaxi expansion
Whether auto/energy margins recover from Q2 2026 lows (1.4% operating margin, energy GM 20%) while capex exceeds $25B
Optimus production timing and credibility of commercial use
Tesla-SpaceX merger speculation and Musk attention/dilution
Macro/AI-equity sentiment given ~150-200x forward P/E, which makes the stock highly multiple-sensitive
reasoning: Spot $372 (~$1.3T). Fundamentals are weak on a near-term basis: Q2 2026 revenue +26% to $28.2B and deliveries 480k (+25%), but operating margin 1.4%, non-GAAP EPS $0.33 (miss vs ~$0.52), FCF -$1.09B on capex $5.8B, and capex guided >$25B with negative FCF expected for the rest of 2026; cash $43.5B cushions. Consensus 2026 EPS ~$1.77, 2027 ~$2.20, so the stock trades at ~170x/150x; analyst mean target ~$397 (range $125-$600), ratings mixed-positive. Autonomy is real but early: paid Cybercab rides in Austin since Sep 3, robotaxis unsupervised in six metros, ~550 vehicles in Texas, >1M unsupervised miles, FSD subs 1.48M (+56%), FSD Supervised in China and 7 EU countries; offsetting NHTSA escalation to a Special Order. My SOTP fair value ~$335 is modestly below spot, but I do not expect fundamental valuation to be the binding constraint within 12 months since the market has sustained a large autonomy premium; I set the distribution median ~$365 (slight negative drift toward fair value, offset by catalyst-rich tape) with lognormal sigma ~0.50 (above the 46% realized vol to reflect binary regulatory/product events and fat tails on both sides, e.g. the 26% July drawdown). Scenario mean (0.25*220 + 0.5*370 + 0.25*600 = $390) sits slightly above the median consistent with right skew. P(>=372) = 0.48. Research used web search only; no option data consulted.
